QuestInfo.name: Creature of the Distant Seas
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1092007##k says you are just in time. Wonder why his eyes are all covered up.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p1092007##k says he found a Strange Creature from the distant seas. There's something not-quite-right about it, and he wants your help figuring it out.
QuestInfo.2: You fought the Strange Creature and returned with its Black Energy. How gloomy...

0.1: A few days ago, I caught this Strange Creature in the ocean, but for the life of me, I can't figure out what it is. It makes these weird noises, and vanishes if you attack it. If it can't be hit, I'm out of ideas...\r\n
0.2: Why don't you figure this out? You want to try?

yes.0: All right. Approach it with caution, and do what you can. If you learn anything, let me know immediately.
yes.1: When you're ready, let me know, and I'll toss you in the room where the Strange Creature is. Don't worry...I'll let you back out.

no.0: We need to do this for the sake of the Pirates. We can't let something like this go without figuring out how to destroy it!

1.0: Oh, you did it. Good. So, this is its true identity?

yes.0: We need to study this. Studying is not one of my stronger skills, by the way.

item.0: You didn't see the Strange Creature? Are you blind?
